dossier_meta.catalog_title: Informal Conjecture (Polynomial Quantitative Bound for Complexity 1 Systems)
dossier_meta.statement_text: For complexity 1 systems, the dependence of $\delta$ on $\epsilon$ in Definition 1.10 satisfies $\delta = \epsilon^{O_A(1)}$, i.e., polynomial dependence.
dossier_meta.context_text: In Section 1.2, after defining complexity 1 (Definition 1.10), the authors remark that the general dependence of $\delta$ on $\epsilon$ is a wide open problem and state conjecturally that polynomial dependence holds. Reference [20] is cited for further discussion of this quantitative question.
